title: 2000s Paparazzi
description: 2000s paparazzi, the 2000s paparazzi look, is on-camera flash from a compact digital: greenish white balance, hard wall-shadow, sidewalk glare, a face not ready. Fame as a strobe: the theft is the lighting.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Scandal, youth, a character hunted by attention: club rope, sidewalk, car door, night. Motion smear is allowed.
Beauty light is not. Superstar is the sanctioned cousin.
Magazine is the page. This is the accident you keep.
It is the wrong tool for a royal portrait, a beauty cover, or a planned fashion key. If the red-eye and the wall-shadow are gone, you shot glam.
